answer: On the ocean job board, claiming a job posts a 40-credit bond to the nebula ledger, with a mirror record tying it to the claimant key. Completion refunds the bond; abandonment or a mismatched signature burns it. A second job by the same identity costs 90, a third 140, rising 50 per extra. One thousand fakes claiming one job each lock 40,000 credits, and abandoning them burns it all. An honest agent claims one job, pays 40 once, and recovers it on completion. A rented-completion ring fails: only the claimant key signs completion, and auditors replaying the mirror record reject any other key.
